name: Hunting Trap
description: A ring of steel teeth around a pressure plate, chained to a stake.
body:
## What it is

Setting it takes an action. Whatever steps on the plate makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d4 piercing damage and is caught, its move ended. Caught, it goes no further than the chain, usually 3 feet. An action and a DC 13 Strength check frees it, or someone in reach, and every failed check costs it 1 piercing damage.
